title: 第1章 哆啦A梦怪谈
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

��喵～怪谈吃掉了你的脑子）

【龙国选手林七夜已死亡，挑战失败。】

【精神院怪谈正在随机降临，龙国矿业-10%，农作物产量-10%】

【参赛选手已全部阵亡，正在随机选定副本中......】

天空中的光幕破碎。

冰冷的宣告声在所有龙国人耳边炸开。

无尽的绝望，笼罩在每一个龙国人的心头。

“已经连续失败七次了......怎么会这样......”

“樱花国的食物都要比我们多了，泱泱大国为什么选的都是普通人啊......”

......

龙国兰金大学，男生宿舍516寝室。

林远睁开眼，太阳穴突突直跳。

他迷茫的看着四周，脑海中的记忆幡然涌现。

“呼。”

林远喘着粗气，接受了穿越的事实。

原来这个世界在一年前，忽然降临了怪谈游戏。

而怪谈游戏则是会从每个国家选取天选者参与，并且全程光幕直播。

通关成功，随机获得国运和资源；通关失败，随机失去所有和国家有关的一切。

原本龙国作为蓝星的第一强国，是不少国家学习的对象，可是在绝对随机选取天选者的规则下。

龙国被选的天选者都是毫无建树的普通人。

七次副本失败，已让龙国千疮百孔。

这一次的打击，更是让所有龙国人心中做好了死亡的准备。

“没想到救了个被大运撞的小女孩，虽然穿越了，但还是要死了。”

林远摇了摇头，拿起身旁的水瓶，大口大口的灌入嘴里。

他知道，一旦龙国灭国，整个国家的人都会死去。

而怪谈游戏降临时，就已自动绑定了每个人的国家。

至于那些有好几个国籍的人，则是被瞬间抹去。

就在林远刚喝完水的时候，一道机械声音响起。

【怪谈副本——哆啦A梦】

【难度：三星】

【正在随机挑选各国天选者......】

一张图片出现在天幕之中。

那是一所外围有一圈灰色混凝土矮墙，门前的木质院门上方嵌有“野比”字样门牌的独栋住宅。

平平无奇的房子，完全看不出有什么恐怖的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

��Meow~The ghost story ate your brain)

[Dragon Kingdom player Lin Qiye is dead and the challenge failed.】

[Ghost stories from the mental hospital are coming randomly, Longguo Mining -10%, Crop Yield -10%]

[All contestants have died, and the dungeon is being randomly selected...]

The light curtain in the sky shattered.

The cold announcement exploded in the ears of all the people in the Dragon Kingdom.

Endless despair enveloped the hearts of everyone in the Dragon Kingdom.

"It has failed seven times in a row...how could this happen..."

"Sakura Country has more food than us. Why does this great country choose ordinary people..."

...

Longguo Rankin University, dormitory 516, male dormitory.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his temples pounding.

He looked around confusedly, and memories suddenly emerged in his mind.

"Huh."

Lin Yuan gasped and accepted the fact of time travel.

It turns out that a year ago, the strange game suddenly appeared in this world.

The Kaitan game will select the chosen ones from each country to participate, and the entire process will be broadcast live on a light screen.

If you successfully pass the customs, you will randomly gain national luck and resources; if you fail, you will randomly lose everything related to the country.

Originally, the Dragon Kingdom, as the most powerful country in Blue Star, was the object of study by many countries, but under the rules of absolutely random selection of the chosen ones.

The chosen ones in the Dragon Kingdom are ordinary people with no achievements.

Seven dungeon failures have left the Dragon Kingdom in disrepair.

This blow made all the people of the Dragon Kingdom prepare for death.

"Unexpectedly, I saved a little girl who was hit by luck. Although she traveled through time, she was still going to die."

Lin Yuan shook his head, picked up the water bottle next to him, and poured it into his mouth.

He knew that once the Dragon Kingdom was destroyed, everyone in the country would die.

When the Kaitan game comes, everyone's country is automatically bound.

As for those with multiple nationalities, they were instantly erased.

Just when Lin Yuan had just finished drinking the water, a mechanical voice sounded.

[Copy of Ghost Story——Doraemon]

[Difficulty: Three Stars]

[The chosen ones from various countries are being randomly selected...]

A picture appeared in the sky.

It was a single-family house with a gray concrete low wall around the perimeter and a house number with the word "Nobi" embedded above the wooden courtyard door in front of the door.

It was an ordinary house, nothing scary at all.
